Sourcing, coordination and movement are: Sourcing, coordination and movement are usually handled by separate companies, and the buyer carries the seams between them. We hold all three, which is what makes a single conversation possible.

One point of contact across production t: One point of contact across production timelines, order details, documentation and handover, so nothing is lost in the gap between one stage and the next.
